method: Viewed all three exact 6x nearest-neighbour comparisons beside official logos, final portraits and rebuilt review board.

observations.codex: Cloud silhouette sampled from official logo alpha after isolating it from the opaque white app tile. Four gradient bands, one-cell blue rim, thick terminal strokes at official relative bounds.
observations.gemini_chest: 19-cell official BOX silhouette at 0.5 coverage; concave stepped sides and four equal pointed tips. Official RGB averages snapped to requested nine-color palette with darker local-color edges.
observations.gemini_visor: 9-cell official BOX silhouette at 0.5 coverage; concave stepped shoulders and four equal pointed tips. Same palette sampling and edge shading as chest.

limitations: Coarse 12px/13px logical cells approximate curves. Literal RGB BOX sampling includes white-background coverage at boundary cells before palette quantization.
Codex supplied alpha contains the white app tile; connected cloud isolation and filling enclosed glyph holes are required before alpha downsampling.
